name: slices
description: What a bolt's slices give its card, its board item and its gate: each slice's cuts as ordered steps, its cuts, data, entry and cuts done, and what the pack's graph shows of its data and entry (docs/design/slice-method.md).

messages.cardSlices:
Run each slice's scaffold command first: it writes each cut's own code and test and keeps what exists. Then build its cuts in order, each one's failing test before its code. The reviewer reports a cut the diff leaves missing, or hollow: a stub, or a test that passes without its code.
{{slices}}

mapPage.title: Slices
mapPage.description: Each slice of each domain, layer by layer, planned, partial or done, with its hand-offs to other slices and domains; written at every merge, never by hand.

SLICE-DATA.fix: name each data node the slice's code reaches in its declaration's data part, or reach it through the domain model (docs: Building a slice)

SLICE-INTEGRATE.fix: name each client, adapter, extension and integration event the slice's code reaches in its declaration's calls, emits or consumes, and drop one its code does not reach (docs: Building a slice)

SLICE-GOVERN.fix: declare the permission the slice needs, composed by aidlc name permission, and leave authentication and authorization to the stages its entry applies (docs: What a slice declares)
